user_query: Analyze this protein sequence for its likely molecular function, cellular processes, subcellular localization, homologous proteins, and domains. Distinguish curated annotation from homology-based inference and report uncertainty.

warnings: Sequence-derived estimates assume an unmodified protein and do not account for processing, PTMs, bound ligands, or oligomers.

alternative_names: ATP synthase F1 sector gamma subunit
F-ATPase gamma subunit
annotation.organism: Mesoplasma florum (strain ATCC 33453 / NBRC 100688 / NCTC 11704 / L1)
function: Produces ATP from ADP in the presence of a proton gradient across the membrane. The gamma chain is believed to be important in regulating ATPase activity and the flow of protons through the CF(0) complex.
subunit: F-type ATPases have 2 components, CF(1) - the catalytic core - and CF(0) - the membrane proton channel. CF(1) has five subunits: alpha(3), beta(3), gamma(1), delta(1), epsilon(1). CF(0) has three main subunits: a, b and c.
similarity: Belongs to the ATPase gamma chain family.
